    Templates¶

    rn_forge.tooling.templates ¶

    Strict Jinja2 rendering from filesystem or package templates.

    RenderError(message, *message_args, error_code=-1, **error_data) ¶

    Bases: AppException

    A template could not be loaded, compiled, or rendered.

    check(value, message, *message_args, **kwargs) classmethod ¶

    Raise this exception if value is falsy.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    value Any

    The value to test.

    		 required
    message str

    Exception message (supports positional format args).

    		 required
    *message_args Any

    Forwarded to message.format().

    		 ()
    **kwargs Any

    Forwarded as error_code / error_data to the constructor.

    		 {}

    Example::

    AppException.check(path.exists(), "Missing file: {}", path, error_code=404)

    TemplateEngine(*, directory=None, package=None, package_path='templates', strict=True, **environment_kwargs) ¶

    Render templates from a directory or a package, with strict undefined handling.

    Initialize :class:TemplateEngine.

    Exactly one of directory or package must be given.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    directory str | None

    A filesystem directory of templates (jinja2.FileSystemLoader).

    		 None
    package str | None

    A Python package name whose package_path subdirectory holds templates (jinja2.PackageLoader) — the resource loads even when the package is installed as a zipped wheel.

    		 None
    package_path str

    Subdirectory within package holding templates. Only meaningful with package.

    		 'templates'
    strict bool

    Use jinja2.StrictUndefined (default) so referencing an undefined variable raises instead of rendering empty.

    		 True
    **environment_kwargs Any

    Forwarded to the jinja2.Environment constructor (e.g. trim_blocks, lstrip_blocks). keep_trailing_newline=True is the default unless overridden here.

    		 {}

    Raises:

    Type Description
    ValueError

    Both or neither of directory/package are given.

    environment property ¶

    The underlying jinja2.Environment — the escape hatch.

    render(name, context) ¶

    Render a named template from the configured directory or package.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    RenderError

    The template cannot be loaded, compiled, or evaluated.

    render_string(template, context) ¶

    Render an inline template string.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    RenderError

    The template cannot be compiled or evaluated.

    validate() ¶

    Compile every template visible to the loader; return error messages.

    Returns [] (rather than raising TypeError) for an environment whose loader does not support listing templates.
